schema.name: d1_migrations
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE "d1_migrations"(
		id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
		name       TEXT UNIQUE,
		applied_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL
)

schema.name: environment_check
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE environment_check (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    value TEXT NOT NULL
)

schema.name: guestbook_gate
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE guestbook_gate (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1),
  next_allowed_at INTEGER NOT NULL
)

schema.name: guestbook_posts
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE guestbook_posts (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  message TEXT NOT NULL,
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'approved'))
)

schema.name: guestbook_public
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX guestbook_public ON guestbook_posts(status, created_at DESC, id DESC)

schema.name: page_request_daily
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE "page_request_daily" (
  day TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (day GLOB '????-??-??'),
  page TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (page IN ('home', 'research', 'observations', 'guestbook', 'agent_traps', 'agents_and_traps')),
  requests INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (requests >= 1),
  PRIMARY KEY (day, page)
)

schema.name: page_requests
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE "page_requests" (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  received_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  day TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (day = substr(received_at, 1, 10)),
  page TEXT NOT NULL,
  status INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (status BETWEEN 100 AND 599),
  user_agent TEXT CHECK (length(user_agent) <= 512),
  referrer_domain TEXT CHECK (length(referrer_domain) <= 253),
  FOREIGN KEY (day, page) REFERENCES "page_request_daily"(day, page) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
